extDescription.message: When you open a URL that is already open in another tab, focus that tab instead of loading it again.

optIntro.message: When you open a URL that is already open in another tab, the existing tab is focused and the new one closed. Changes apply when you press Save.

modeBlacklist.message: Act on every URL except those in the blacklist

modeWhitelist.message: Act only on URLs in the whitelist

fCloseDuplicate.message: Close the duplicate tab (if off, only focus the existing one)

fFocusWindow.message: Bring the window of the existing tab to the front

fInTab.message: If the duplicate URL opens in a tab that already had a page

inTabBack.message: Focus the existing tab and go back in that tab

inTabClose.message: Focus the existing tab and close that tab

pinnedProtect.message: Never close them, but focus them

pinnedNormal.message: Treat them like any other tab

groupSame.message: Only tabs in the same group (ungrouped counts as a group)

incognitoShared.message: Compare across normal and incognito (needs incognito permission)

fRestoreMinimized.message: Restore the window if minimized when focusing

fActOnReload.message: Also act when reloading a page that is already in another tab

fShowBadge.message: Show the avoided-duplicates counter on the icon

fCountFocusOnly.message: Also count when only focusing (no close or back)

rankingHelp.message: When several tabs show the same page, the one meeting the first criterion is focused (or kept); on a tie, the next one. Untick the ones you do not want.

rankGroup.message: Is in the same group as the originating tab

rankActive.message: Is the active tab of its window

normHelp.message: Two URLs are the same page when they match after applying these rules.

qHelp.message: "Significant" parameters are always compared; "ignored" ones never; the rest according to the checkbox. Glob patterns are allowed (utm_*). One pattern per line or comma separated.

whitelistHelp.message: In "whitelist only" mode it limits where the extension acts. In "blacklist" mode it restricts nothing, but its parameter settings apply to matching URLs (handy to customize one site).

blacklistHelp.message: In "blacklist" mode the extension never acts on matching URLs.

testHelp.message: Check what the extension would do with a URL using the settings in the form (even unsaved ones).

reasonInternal.message: No action: internal or non-http(s) URL

reasonNotWhitelisted.message: No action: does not match the whitelist

reasonOk.message: Acts: will focus the existing tab

importExportHelp.message: Export the configuration as JSON or import a previous one. Import and reset only fill the form: press Save to apply.

importLoaded.message: Configuration imported. Press Save to apply it.

helpEnabled.message: Master switch. When off the extension does nothing and the icon shows OFF. Also toggled from the popup or with Alt+Shift+F.

helpMode.message: "Except blacklist": acts on any site except those matching the blacklist. "Whitelist only": acts only on sites in the whitelist.

helpCloseDuplicate.message: When an already open URL is opened in a new tab, close that new tab after focusing the existing one. Unticked, it only focuses and leaves the new tab loading.

helpFocusWindow.message: If the existing tab lives in another window, bring that window to the front. Unticked, only the tab is activated inside its window.

helpInTab.message: What to do when the duplicate URL is typed or followed from a tab that already showed another page. "Go back" focuses the existing tab and returns this tab to its previous page (the duplicate loads for an instant).

helpScope.message: Where to look for the already open tab: every browser window, or only the window where the URL is opened.

helpPinned.message: Pinned tabs can be protected (focused but never closed), ignored (neither focused nor closed) or treated like any other tab.

helpGroups.message: "Ignore": a tab inside a group and one outside are duplicates. "Same group only": only tabs in the same group are compared; ungrouped tabs form a group of their own. To prefer the same group without excluding the rest, use the "same group" criterion in the priority list.

helpIncognito.message: Incognito tabs are only visible if you allow the extension in incognito (chrome://extensions). "Never mix": a normal tab only matches normal tabs and an incognito tab only incognito ones.

helpWindowTypes.message: Installed web apps (PWAs) and popup windows also have tabs. Choose whether they count as candidates or only regular windows are searched.

helpRestoreMinimized.message: If the existing tab is in a minimized window, restore it when focusing. Unticked, the tab is activated but the window stays minimized.

helpActOnReload.message: By default reloading a page (or typing its own URL) is not a duplicate even if another tab shows it. Ticked, the same action as an in-tab navigation applies.

helpShowBadge.message: Shows the number of avoided duplicates on the extension icon. Reset it from the popup.

helpCountFocusOnly.message: Ticked, also counts when the extension only focuses the existing tab without closing or going back. Unticked, only closes and go-backs count.

helpTieBreak.message: When several tabs tie on every ticked criterion, the oldest or the newest one is focused (or kept).

helpNormFragment.message: Ignore what follows # (in-page anchor). example.com/doc#ch2 and example.com/doc are the same page.

helpNormWww.message: www.example.com and example.com are the same page.

helpNormScheme.message: http://example.com and https://example.com are the same page.

helpNormTrailingSlash.message: example.com/path/ and example.com/path are the same page.

helpNormPort.message: example.com:8080 and example.com are the same page. Default ports (80, 443) are always ignored.

helpNormHostCase.message: EXAMPLE.com and example.com are the same page. The browser already lowercases the host, so in practice this always holds.

helpNormPathCase.message: example.com/Doc and example.com/doc are the same page. Many servers are case-sensitive in the path; enable only if you know yours is not.

helpQCompare.message: Ticked, parameters (?a=1&b=2) take part in the comparison except the ignored ones. Unticked, all are ignored except the significant ones. Each whitelist rule can override this for its site.

helpQOrderMatters.message: Unticked, ?a=1&b=2 and ?b=2&a=1 are the same page. Ticked, order counts.

helpQIgnored.message: Parameters never compared, one per line or comma separated. Wildcards allowed: utm_* covers utm_source, utm_medium… Typical: campaign and tracking identifiers.

helpQSignificant.message: Parameters always compared, even when "Compare parameters" is unticked or they match an ignored pattern. Useful for the identifier that defines the page (v on YouTube, id on a forum).

helpRulePattern.message: Glob without "/": domain and subdomains (example.com, *.google.com, localhost:8080). Glob with "/": full URL without scheme, anchored; use * for prefixes (github.com/org/*). Regex: over the full URL; /body/flags allowed.

helpRuleType.message: Glob: * matches any text and ? one character; everything else is literal. Regex: JavaScript regular expression over the full URL (https://…).

helpRuleQueryCompare.message: For URLs matching this rule: inherit the global "Compare parameters" setting, or force compare/ignore.

helpRuleQueryIgnored.message: Ignored parameters for this rule only, comma separated. Empty = inherit the global list.

helpRuleQuerySignificant.message: Always-significant parameters for this rule only, comma separated. Empty = inherit the global list.

statusResetPending.message: Defaults loaded. Press Save to apply them.
